documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Cyber Media Research & Services Limited reported its best-ever financial performance for FY25-26, with revenue growing by 20.62% to INR 91.60 crore and EBITDA increasing by 45.06% to INR 5.42 crore. Management highlighted growth across its core business segments, continued expansion of its AI and SaaS product CMGalaxy, and an ongoing merger process with CMIL expected to complete by December 2026 to March 2027. The company anticipates outpacing industry growth in the upcoming financial year despite macroeconomic and geopolitical challenges. Cyber Media Research & Services Limited held its Q2FY26 earnings conference call, reporting a top line of INR 43.55 crore and EBITDA of INR 2.69 crore for H1FY25-26. Management highlighted growth across international business, programmatic advertising, and market research, alongside an expected merger with Cyber Media (India) Limited.

guidance.claim: The management expects to continue growing the team and business across India and international markets at a faster rate than the current industry growth.
guidance.quote: Despite the geopolitical uncertainty and the macroeconomic impact on Indian economy, the management expects to continue growing the team and the business not only in India, but across international markets as well. We expect to do this at a faster rate than the current industry growth that has been slated.

guidance.claim: The company aims to onboard up to 100 logos for CMGalaxy in the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Our aim is to onboard up to 100 logos this financial year, and we are highly ambitious about this goal.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver its best financial year performance.
guidance.quote: We expect to deliver CMRSL's best financial year performance.

guidance.claim: Management expects cost savings of at least INR 1 crore annually in a merged entity.
guidance.quote: The management expects a cost saving of at least INR 1 crore annually in a merged entity.

demand_outlook.claim: The growth pipeline for FY26-27 remains very strong, with expectations to continue outpacing the industry despite geopolitical challenges.
demand_outlook.quote: The growth pipeline for FY26-27 remains very strong. We expect to continue outpacing the industry in the coming year despite geopolitical challenges.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is experiencing a transition from linear TV towards ConnectedTV as a major industry trend.
demand_outlook.quote: There has been a transition from linear TV towards ConnectedTV. This is again a major industry trend.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates very positive overall growth for FY27 after starting the current year on a good note.
demand_outlook.quote: We are anticipating at a very positive overall growth for FY27. As I mentioned earlier, we have started the current year on a good note, and we are looking at a year where we will outpace the industry growth by a good margin.

demand_outlook.claim: CMRSL's international business expanded by about 30%.
demand_outlook.quote: CMRSL’s international business also expanded about 30%.

demand_outlook.claim: In the first half of the year, the media business grew by 33% compared to the previous financial year.
demand_outlook.quote: In the first half of the year, the media business grew by 33% compared to the previous financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: The revenue of CMIL grew from INR 35.73 crore in H1 of last year to INR 43.14 crore in H1 of this year.
demand_outlook.quote: The revenue of CMIL has grown from INR 35.73 crore in H1 of last year to INR 43.14 crore in H1 of this year.

margins_costs.claim: The growth in EBITDA demonstrates a commitment to improving profit margins.
margins_costs.quote: The growth in EBITDA shows a clear commitment towards not only top-line growth, but also in improving our margins, an area that we have committed to investors in the past calls.

margins_costs.claim: Research and publisher monetization businesses had double-digit margins, while the advertiser business had high single-digit margins.
margins_costs.quote: In the research business as well as the publisher monetization business, we would have had double-digit margins, whereas in the advertiser business, we would have had high single-digit margin.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects the consolidated structure from the merger to drive significant cost optimization.
margins_costs.quote: The management expects this consolidated structure to drive significant cost optimization.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for H1FY25-26 improved from 5.1% to 6.2% as compared to the previous financial year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for H1FY25-26 improved from 5.1% to 6.2% as compared to the previous financial year.

margins_costs.claim: The total merger cost is estimated between INR 40 Lakh to INR 50 Lakh.
margins_costs.quote: The total merger cost is estimated between INR 40 Lakh to INR 50 Lakh.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the platform's data costs are very optimized despite handling large and complex data sets.
margins_costs.quote: On the data front, our costs are very optimized.

orders_capacity.claim: The company retained its customer base and added a fair number of large new accounts during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company not only retained its customer base, but also added a fair number of large new accounts during the year.

orders_capacity.claim: More than 50 logos were added in the digital marketing business during FY25-26.
orders_capacity.quote: We added more than 50 logos in our digital marketing business during FY25-26.

orders_capacity.claim: CMGalaxy has onboarded 12 new logos, mostly in the D2C and education space.
orders_capacity.quote: We have already onboarded 12 new logos. These are mostly in the D2C and the education space.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-equity ratio reduced to 0.26 times as on March 31, 2026, compared to 0.35 times as on March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The debt-equity ratio reduced to 0.26 times as on 31st March, 2026 as compared to 0.35 times as on 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The rights issue was subscribed as 82.38%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Negative news impacting dollars is being heard, but positive growth is expected based on rolled-out products and services.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you know, we have been hearing a lot of news coming out, which are negatively impacting dollars. Having said that, we are seeing positive growth based on the services and products that we are rolling out, and expect this to be a strong financial year.

risks_headwinds.claim: The international business was relatively flat in YoY comparison, and dollar appreciation had a reciprocal impact on revenues.
risks_headwinds.quote: In terms of the YoY comparison, our international business was relatively flat. The appreciation in dollar is having the reciprocal impact as far as revenues are concerned, despite about a 6 to 7% appreciation over the last six-seven months.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that API ecosystems for quick commerce platforms like Blinkit and Zomato are limited to their own platforms.
risks_headwinds.quote: The other part is the Blinkit, Zomato of the world, doesn't have a correct API.

management_commitments.claim: Completion of the merger with CMIL is anticipated between December 2026 and March 2027 subject to timely regulatory approvals.
management_commitments.quote: Given that the merger involves multiple statutory authorities, completion is anticipated between December 2026 and March 2027, subject to timely regulatory approvals.

management_commitments.claim: The merger is likely to take approximately six to nine months' time.
management_commitments.quote: The merger is likely to take approx. six to nine months' time, subject to approvals from relevant authorities involved.

management_commitments.claim: The rights issue will be closed in the coming quarter much before the merger happens.
management_commitments.quote: The rights issue will be closed in the coming quarter much before the merger happened.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
